requirement_text.REQ-001b:
Depends on REQ-001a, which lands the next-intl dependency, the app/[locale] routing/middleware skeleton, the working Nav.tsx locale switcher, and messages/ru.json + messages/uz.json seeded from only src/app/layout.tsx's strings (now merged to master via PR #5). This requirement extracts the remaining hardcoded copy from all 12 landing components under src/components/landing/ (Band, Creed, Doors, Events, Footer, Hero, MapSection, Metrics, Nav, Partners, Streams, Team) into the same two catalogs, and updates each component to read its copy from the catalog via next-intl's hooks (`useTranslations` in client components, `getTranslations` in server components, as appropriate per each component's existing client/server status) instead of inline strings. As with REQ-001a's seed keys, every new messages/uz.json value added here is populated with the Russian source string duplicated verbatim as a placeholder — translation content is out of scope for this requirement; REQ-002 (depends_on this requirement and REQ-001a) replaces every uz placeholder, from both requirements' keys, with real Uzbek copy.

Acceptance criteria: (1) every hardcoded user-facing string in the 12 landing components is replaced with a next-intl translation call, verified by grepping each component file for remaining literal Cyrillic text — none should remain outside of messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json; (2) messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json each contain a key for every string extracted from the 12 components, in addition to the REQ-001a keys already present, with matching key sets between the two catalogs; (3) every messages/uz.json key added by this requirement has a non-empty value (placeholder duplicate acceptable); (4) npm run build completes with no type or routing errors after all 12 components are wired to next-intl hooks; (5) visiting /ru and /uz both render all 12 landing sections with no missing-translation-key runtime errors or fallback warnings in the build/start output.

task.description: Design the extraction plan for REQ-001b per WF-02 Step 1. Read src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx and src/i18n/routing.ts, request.ts, navigation.ts (created by REQ-001a, now on master) to understand the actual current next-intl setup before designing anything new. Read all 12 landing components under src/components/landing/ (Band, Creed, Doors, Events, Footer, Hero, MapSection, Metrics, Nav, Partners, Streams, Team) yourself to catalog every hardcoded string that needs extraction — do not estimate or guess at their content. Write docs/agents/design/REQ-001b.md covering: the message catalog namespace/key structure for each of the 12 components (propose a sensible per-component namespace, e.g. one top-level key per component matching its filename, to keep messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json organized as they grow — but state your reasoning, don't just assert it), which components are Server vs Client Components today (check for 'use client' directives) since that determines useTranslations vs getTranslations usage, any component whose copy includes dynamic/templated content (e.g. an array.join or interpolated value) since content_ba_guide.md flags 'empty-array copy' as a known pitfall requiring a fallback — flag any case found rather than silently handling it. List open questions explicitly (e.g. any component with copy that doesn't map cleanly to a flat key structure) rather than guessing.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of the 12 landing components has a corresponding message-catalog section named in the design
Client vs Server Component status stated per component, with the correct next-intl hook (useTranslations/getTranslations) named for each
Any dynamic/templated/array-interpolated copy is flagged explicitly as an open question or handled with a stated fallback approach, not silently glossed over
No .tsx implementation code blocks present — structure, types, and prose only
Every acceptance criterion in REQ-001b's requirement_text maps to a concrete design element
